### EDA

```{r}
heart <- read.csv("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/imteekay/heart-failure-prediction/main/heart.csv")
```

# 2. Data Preprocessing

# Remove observations with missing values
```{r}
heart <- na.omit(heart)
```

# Convert categorical predictors to factors
```{r}
heart$Sex <- as.factor(heart$Sex)
heart$ChestPainType <- as.factor(heart$ChestPainType)
heart$RestingECG <- as.factor(heart$RestingECG)
heart$ExerciseAngina <- as.factor(heart$ExerciseAngina)
heart$ST_Slope <- as.factor(heart$ST_Slope)
```
# Convert FastingBS to a factor (binary category)
```{r}
heart$FastingBS <- as.factor(heart$FastingBS)
```

### PCA and Kmeans

# Make dummy variables

```{r}
library(fastDummies)
dummy_heart<-dummy_cols(heart, select_columns=c("Sex", "ChestPainType","RestingECG", "FastingBS", "ExerciseAngina", "ST_Slope"), remove_first_dummy=T,
remove_selected_columns = TRUE)
```

```{r}

scaled_heart_data <- scale( dummy_heart )
distance <- dist ( scaled_heart_data ) 

twcss<-numeric(10)
for (k in 1:10) {
  set.seed(380)
  km <- kmeans(scaled_heart_data, centers = k, nstart = 25)
  twcss[k] <- km$tot.withinss
}

plot(1:10, twcss, type = "b", pch = 19, frame = FALSE,
     xlab = "Number of clusters K",
     ylab = "Total Within-Cluster Sum of Squares (TWCSS)",
     main = "Elbow Method to Choose K")

```

```{r}
set.seed(380)
library(cluster)
avg_sil <- numeric() 
for (k in 2:10) { 
  set.seed(1)
  km <- kmeans(scaled_heart_data, centers = k, nstart = 25)
  
  
  sil <- silhouette(km$cluster, dist(scaled_heart_data))
  avg_sil[k] <- mean(sil[, 3])  # column 3 is 
}

# Plot average silhouette width vs K
plot(2:10, avg_sil[2:10], type = "b", pch = 19, frame = FALSE,
     xlab = "Number of clusters K",
     ylab = "Average Silhouette Width",
     main = "Silhouette Method to Choose K")
```
```{r}
k <- 3
set.seed(380)  # for reproducibility

# Run kmeans
km <- kmeans(scaled_heart_data, centers = k, nstart = 25)
## R will run kmeans nstart number of times with different initialization
library(ggplot2)
# Add cluster assignments to dataframe
heart_df <- as.data.frame(scaled_heart_data)
heart_df$cluster <- km$cluster
head(heart_df)
km$size  
km$centers
```
# PCA

```{r}


pca_heart <- prcomp(
  scaled_heart_data[, colnames(scaled_heart_data) != "HeartDisease"],
  scale. = FALSE
)
summary(pca_heart)
```
```{r}
eigvals <- pca_heart$sdev^2   # variance explained by each PC

# Scree plot
plot(eigvals, type = "b", pch = 19,
     xlab = "Principal Component",
     ylab = "Eigenvalue (Variance Explained)",
     main = "Scree Plot")
```
```{r}
pca_heart$rotation
```

```{r}
pca_plot_df <- data.frame(
  PC1 = pca_heart$x[, 1],
  PC2 = pca_heart$x[, 2],
  cluster = factor(km$cluster)
)

# 2. Plot with ggplot2
ggplot(pca_plot_df, aes(x = PC1, y = PC2, color = cluster)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.7, size = 2.5) +
  labs(
    title = "K-Means Clusters on Heart Dataset (PCA Space)",
    x = "Principal Component 1 (PC1)",
    y = "Principal Component 2 (PC2)",
    color = "Cluster"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```
```{r}
pca_plot_df <- data.frame(
  PC1 = pca_heart$x[, 1],
  PC2 = pca_heart$x[, 2],
  cluster = factor(heart$HeartDisease)
)

# 2. Plot with ggplot2
ggplot(pca_plot_df, aes(x = PC1, y = PC2, color = cluster)) +
```
